title: T-Rex Run 3D
tagline: The Chrome dinosaur game, rebuilt in 3D.
blurb: It's the no-internet dinosaur from Chrome, rebuilt in voxel 3D with cacti, scorpions and pterodactyls. Press Space to start, jump the cacti, duck under the birds and see how far you get.
desc: T-Rex Run 3D by Priler: the Chrome offline dinosaur game rebuilt in voxel 3D. Jump cacti and duck pterodactyls, free in your browser.
author: Abraham Tugalov (Priler)
extraCredit: The start screen is a parody of Chrome's Russian offline page: «Начать игру» means Start game, and Space works too.
